idea-plugin.name: Twig Arcs: Matching Tag & Branch Highlighting
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the Twig block structure next to the tags, like a tag tree for Twig:
  • a dotted curve left of each block's tags ({% if %}, {% for %}, {% block %}, ...), one per branch, so if/else looks like an inverted "3";
  • around the caret: the current branch in green, the other branches in red with greyed-out content;
  • when the caret is on a Twig tag, the other tags of the same block are highlighted;
  • optional backgrounds for {% %}, {{ }} and {# #}.
Colors: Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Twig Arcs.
